channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Alckmin faz campanha para Lula na periferia de SP e destaca abstenção alta no 1º turno
item.description: Alckmin campaigned in Paraisópolis, São Paulo, supporting Lula and emphasizing high voter abstention in the first round. He met with community leaders and residents backing the presidential re-election.

item.title: Juíza contraria Lula, libera Stake, mas deixa pagamentos em aberto
item.description: A federal judge authorized Stake to resume operations in Brazil, contradicting the ban imposed by President Lula, but left payment processing in question since financial institutions are not directly required to restore transactions. The ruling is partial and does not affect other betting houses, as the legal dispute advances ahead of the scheduled withdrawal of player balances.

item.title: União Popular (UP), de Samara Martins, declara apoio a Lula no 2º turno
item.description: The União Popular (UP), the party of Samara Martins, officially announced support for Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in the second round of the presidential election, directing its base toward the candidacy against Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). The decision was made by the party's national executive, which also announced street mobilizations during the campaign, with the slogan 'Vote 13'. Samara Martins received 122,911 votes in the first round, equivalent to 0.10% of valid votes.

item.title: Servidores do TSE são vítimas de ameaças na internet e tribunal pede investigação da PF
item.description: The TSE reinforced security for servers and relatives threatened by disinformation on social media following false fraud accusations. The court requested Federal Police investigation and communications to social networks to combat misinformation. The wave of threats was detected after the first round, with profiles spreading unfounded theories about alleged vote manipulation.

item.title: Lula volta a provocar Flávio sobre PEC da 6x1: "Pare de inventar lorota"
item.description: Lula challenged Flávio Bolsonaro over the PEC ending the 6x1 workweek, demanding a vote and accusing him of inventing 'fluff'. The issue became a priority in the final stretch of the campaign, with the government pushing to approve the shorter workweek before the elections. Flávio opposes the bill and prefers an hourly regime.

item.title: Coligação de Lula pede apuração de criptomoedas por posts pró-Flávio
item.description: Lula's coalition requested an investigation by the Electoral Prosecutor's Office into cryptocurrency distributions in exchange for favorable posts about Flávio Bolsonaro. The Brazil 22 Token project offers B22 tokens to those who promote the candidacy, raising suspicions of paid election advertising and vote buying.

item.title: Flávio não vai reduzir os pisos do orçamento da saúde e educação, diz campanha
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign states there will be no cuts to pensions, minimum wage, or constitutional floors for health and education. Despite this, the candidate keeps the promise to cut R$200 billion from the budget without detailing how. His stance against traditional fiscal reforms sparks controversy among economists.

item.title: Prefeito “tiktoker” de Florianópolis grava vídeo para campanha de Celina
item.description: The mayor of Florianópolis, Topázio Neto, known for his creative social media presence, participated in recordings for the re-election campaign of the governor of the Federal District, Celina Leão, in the second round of elections. The collaboration follows Celina's appointment of Thiago Peixoto, former municipal education secretary of Florianópolis, to head the Education Secretariat of the DF.

item.title: Paes vai ao STF para barrar anulação dos votos de Garotinho
item.description: The coalition of Eduardo Paes (PSD) appealed to the STF to suspend the annulment of votes for Anthony Garotinho (Republicanos), decided by the TSE, which paved the way for Douglas Ruas (PL) to be elected in the first round of the Rio de Janeiro elections. The TSE ordered a recount of votes, excluding those of Garotinho, so that Ruas exceeds 50% of valid votes.

item.title: Presidente do Novo atribui derrota de Zema a voto útil
item.description: The president of Novo, Eduardo Ribeiro, attributed Romeu Zema's defeat in the presidential election to a strong migration of votes to Flávio Bolsonaro in the first round, explaining that right-wing voters anticipated their support for the PL candidate to prevent the PT from winning. Ribeiro noted that Zema was disadvantaged by competing in the same voter segment as Flávio, but emphasized that the poor performance does not diminish the former governor's prestige.

item.title: “Vamos recorrer até o fim”, diz presidente do Novo sobre Deltan
item.description: Eduardo Ribeiro, president of Novo, said the party will appeal to the Supreme Federal Court if the Electoral Superior Court upholds the rejection of Deltan Dallagnol's candidacy, elected senator from Paraná. Minister Floriano de Azevedo Marques deemed Dallagnol ineligible for 8 years for leaving the Federal Prosecutor's Office while under disciplinary procedures. The decision was suspended by TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques, and Dallagnol's votes were counted.

item.title: ‘Não existe cavalo de pau na economia’, diz Durigan sobre eventual Lula 4
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan denied that a potential fourth Lula term would bring drastic economic changes, stating there is 'no magic bullet' and emphasizing fiscal balance since 2024. He defended Lula's track record in restoring public accounts, contrasting it with the deficits left by previous administrations.

item.title: Douglas Ruas diz que vai aguardar retotalização, mas já faz promessas como governador do RJ: 'Declarar guerra ao crime organizado'
item.description: Douglas Ruas stated he will wait for vote retallying but already promised to combat organized crime and prioritize municipalities as governor of RJ. He criticized Eduardo Paes' appeal to the STF and accused opponents of trying to block his victory.

item.title: Paes oficializa ação no STF para tentar 2º turno na disputa pelo governo do Rio de Janeiro
item.description: The coalition of former Rio mayor Eduardo Paes filed a lawsuit at the STF to try to secure the second round in the race for governor of Rio de Janeiro, following the annulment of 274,411 votes for Anthony Garotinho by the TSE. Without Garotinho's votes, Douglas Ruas leads with 50.9% of valid votes, allowing him to win in the first round. The TSE decision was 5 to 2, and the recount of results is scheduled for this Saturday.

item.title: Chapa de Paes vai ao STF pedir suspensão de decisão do TSE que anulou votos de Garotinho
item.description: Eduardo Paes' coalition filed a lawsuit at the STF to suspend the TSE's decision annulling Anthony Garotinho's votes, requesting a recount that could lead to Douglas Ruas being declared Rio's governor in the first round. The TSE had excluded Garotinho's 274,411 votes, allowing Ruas to reach 49.27% and potentially win outright.

item.title: 'Incendiar a UFF de madrugada': após manifestações pró-Lula, estudantes recebem ameaças; reitor aciona Polícia Federal
item.description: UFF students in Niterói receive threats from Flávio Bolsonaro supporters after pro-Lula demonstrations. Rector Fábio Passos filed a report with the Federal Police and increased security on campus.

item.title: MDB planeja ato para declarar apoio de 16 diretórios estaduais a Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: PL candidate Flávio Bolsonaro moves closer to forming a second-round coalition by securing the backing of 16 state directories of the MDB, following a virtual meeting with the party's national president, Baleia Rossi. The alignment was led by Tarcísio de Freitas and Ricardo Nunes, with an event scheduled to celebrate the party's engagement, as the MDB signals support more collectively than through formal decisions.

item.title: TRE-RJ marca para sábado a retotalização de votos que deve confirmar Douglas Ruas como governador
item.description: The TRE-RJ scheduled the vote recount for next Saturday, when Douglas Ruas is expected to be declared elected governor in the first round, after the TSE annulled Anthony Garotinho's votes due to ineligibility. The decision eliminates the possibility of a runoff with Eduardo Paes, who is trying to reverse the decision at the STF. Ruas leads with 49.2% of the votes, and with Garotinho's annulment, he surpasses 50% of valid votes.

item.title: A recusa de Ciro Nogueira em posar para foto com Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Ciro Nogueira declined Flávio Bolsonaro's invitation for a photo after the PP and União Brasil federation agreed to support the runoff.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro fala em fim da reeleição e em estender eventual mandato
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro advocates for ending reelection and proposes an eventual presidential term of four to five years, as defined by Congress. He states he will not change the law barring relatives in presidential succession but suggests constitutional changes without specifying details. Support from Podemos and remarks about Jair Bolsonaro in 2030 sparked debates on authoritarianism and institutionalism.

item.title: Fux determina que área técnica do STF libere acesso aos inquéritos das fake news, da milícia digital e trama golpista
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Luiz Fux ordered access to confidential investigations on fake news, digital militias, and a coup plot involving Jair Bolsonaro and allies after a lawsuit by the PP. The ruling challenges Alexandre de Moraes' decision to keep the cases under seal, arguing it violates constitutional principles.

item.title: Quem são os 12 governadores eleitos que foram dar apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) gathered support from 12 elected governors and 2 runoff candidates in a Brasília event, emphasizing federal cooperation and criticism of Lula's government.

item.title: PSDB mantém neutralidade no 2º turno
item.description: The Brazilian Social Democracy Party (PSDB) decided to remain neutral in the 2026 runoff election, allowing its members to freely support either Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) or Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT). The decision was announced in a statement signed by the party's national president, Aécio Neves, following consultations with regional branches. Most local leaders were split between supporting Bolsonaro and neutrality, with a small minority backing Lula.

item.title: Petrobras e BB não serão privatizados, diz coordenador de plano de Flávio
item.description: Adolfo Sachsida, economic coordinator for Flávio Bolsonaro's plan, stated that Petrobras, Caixa, and Banco do Brasil will not be privatized. He advocated for fiscal adjustments, tax cuts, and strengthening social programs while criticizing high public servant salaries.

item.title: Prefeitos pressionam governador do Maranhão por apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro no 2º turno
item.description: Mayors allied with Carlos Brandão pressure the Maranhão governor to support Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round of the election. The coalition gathers around 180 municipal governments. The article is exclusive to news portal subscribers.

item.title: Chefe da economia de Flávio vai segurar a ‘boiada’?
item.description: As the runoff approaches, Flávio Bolsonaro has not yet named a Finance Minister, seeking to avoid internal friction. The market responds confidently to austerity promises and parliamentary majority, but doubts remain about structural fiscal cuts and stance on foreign policy and environmental issues. Critics warn that the next Finance Minister will need autonomy to avoid the marginalization experienced by Paulo Guedes under Bolsonaro.

item.title: Leia decisão de Moraes para início da pena de Eduardo Bolsonaro
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes ordered the immediate commencement of former congressman Eduardo Bolsonaro's (PL-SP) 4-year-and-2-month prison sentence for process obstruction, initially under semi-open regime. The ruling also mandated the seizure of Bolsonaro's passport. The decision was issued on Wednesday (October 7), with the full ruling available in PDF format.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro cita Raquel Lyra e pede empenho de governadores eleitos
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro thanked Pernambuco Governor Raquel Lyra for her neutrality and stressed the importance of elected governors maintaining political mobilization. The senator and reelection candidate called for engagement from first-round winning governors to consolidate the campaign.

item.title: Fim do desmatamento ilegal deve ser prioridade para o próximo governo, diz ex-ministra do Meio Ambiente
item.description: Former Minister of the Environment Izabella Teixeira states that the next Brazilian government must prioritize ending illegal deforestation, implementing COP30 decisions and the Climate Plan to ensure the country's international relevance. She emphasizes that illegal deforestation funds organized crime and that effective public policies are essential to reduce emissions and promote sectoral decarbonization.

item.title: Corra, Lula, corra
item.description: The analysis highlights that, despite reduced odds of Lula reaching the second round, he should remain in the race until October 25th. The content suggests implementing a damage control plan focused on filling strategic positions. The tone emphasizes a defensive strategy to mitigate electoral losses.

item.title: TSE forma maioria para anular votos de Garotinho e abre caminho para eleição de Ruas no RJ
item.description: The TSE formed a majority to annul Anthony Garotinho's 274,411 votes in the October 4 election, enabling Douglas Ruas (PL-RJ) to win with 49.27% of the vote. The ruling, based on rapporteur Floriano de Azevedo Marques' vote, allowed Ruas to become Rio de Janeiro's governor in the first round.

item.title: “O bolsonarismo vai instaurar um golpe no Brasil”, diz Ana Elisa (PT)
item.description: Federal deputy-elect Ana Elisa (PT-MG) warned that Flávio Bolsonaro's election could extend the Bolsonarismo movement for over 30 years, threatening Brazilian democracy. She cited alleged ties to militias and Banco Master while criticizing polarization and anti-PT bias. She advocates focusing on candidate backgrounds in the runoff and recovering votes in Minas Gerais.

item.title: Flávio promete acabar com reeleição já em eventual mandato
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated that, if elected president, he will use his political capital to push for the abolition of reelection in Brazil, working with the National Congress to implement the change.

item.title: Em ato com governadores eleitos, Flávio diz que vai governar para todos
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro met with elected governors who support him and claimed he will govern for all, including those who do not back his candidacy. He highlighted the neutrality of governors like Raquel Lyra and reaffirmed his commitment to helping citizens in every state regardless of party color. Present were Sergio Moro, Tarcísio de Freitas and Zucco.

item.title: TSE tem maioria para anular votos de Garotinho na eleição para o governo do RJ; ASSISTA
item.description: The TSE holds a majority to annul Garotinho's votes in the Rio governor election, which could secure a win for Douglas Ruas in the first round. Justices also rejected Garotinho's request to withdraw legal challenges, increasing the likelihood of ineligibility. With the annulment, the state may not have a runoff.

item.title: Flávio reúne governadores e diz que vai governar “olhando para cada estado”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated he will govern by 'looking at each state,' meeting with governors and allies in Brasília to discuss federal cooperation. He emphasized adapting national policies to state-level experiences without specifying policy agendas.

item.title: Democratas voltam a falar em interferência americana nas eleições do Brasil
item.description: Democratic congressmen in the US raise new questions about alleged interference by the Trump administration in Brazilian elections, demanding answers from the State Department under Marco Rubio. They reference meetings with Jair Bolsonaro, sanctions against Alexandre de Moraes, and the controversial appointment of Darren Beattie as threats to Brazilian institutions.

item.title: Flávio considera mudar correção da Previdência, da saúde e da educação para obter até R$ 250 bi
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's economic team is studying a fiscal measures package to contain mandatory spending and enable an initial adjustment of around 2% of GDP, equivalent to approximately 250 billion reais. Among the considered measures are changes in the correction of Social Security, health, and education.

item.title: Vida selvagem na América Latina despenca 95% desde 1970, alerta WWF
item.description: Latin America and the Caribbean lost 95% of vertebrate biodiversity between 1970 and 2022, according to WWF's Living Planet 2026 report, with agriculture and ecosystem conversion as the main drivers. Brazil stands out with interventions like the Soy Moratorium, but the decline severely impacts amphibians, fish, mammals, birds, and reptiles.

item.title: Brasileirão: confira os melhores momentos dessa quarta-feira (7/10)
item.description: The 29th round of the Brazilian Championship took place on Wednesday (10/7) with wins for Cruzeiro, Vasco, Bragantino and Vitória, plus draws between Corinthians x Remo, Grêmio x Mirassol, and parallel news on politics and security. The competition continues with excitement in the relegation battle and the race for the top.

item.title: Melhores campanhas do returno, Santos e Flamengo jogam pelo Brasileirão
item.description: Santos and Flamengo face off in the 29th round of the Brazilian Championship with identical second-half campaigns. The match takes place at 7:30 PM at Vila Belmiro, featuring a showdown between top scorers Pedro and Gabigol.

item.title: Times da Série A usam patrocínios pontuais no lugar de bets
item.description: On Wednesday (7), the first round of the Brazilian Championship after the ban on sports betting advertisements, in effect since MP 1.394/2026, did not feature betting sponsors on team jerseys. Teams like Internacional, Corinthians and Remo replaced betting brands with temporary or institutional sponsors, while others such as Bragantino and Mirassol kept previous partnerships.

item.title: Datafolha divulga primeira pesquisa presidencial do 2º turno nesta quinta-feira (8)
item.description: Datafolha releases its first presidential poll for the second round between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT) following a tight first-round result. The survey interviews 2,520 voters between October 6-8, with a two-point margin of error.

item.title: Em 2 cidades, Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula tiveram o exato mesmo número de votos para presidente no 1º turno
item.description: In the 2026 Brazilian presidential election first round, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT) tied with exactly 679 votes in Crixás do Tocantins and 575 votes in Trabiju (SP). The race proved extremely close, with the narrowest historical margin of 1.87 percentage points, setting up a runoff on October 25th.

item.title: Lula perde terreno nas cidades pequenas, enquanto Flávio Bolsonaro avança no interior
item.description: In the 2026 municipal elections, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) lost electoral leadership especially in cities with up to 10,000 inhabitants, while Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) advanced in the countryside. Of the 579 municipalities that no longer have Lula as leader, 365 are small cities, representing 63% of the total, according to first-round data. The president's decline was sharper in the South and small towns, maintaining stable performance only in large urban centers.

item.title: TSE deve julgar nesta quinta desistência de recurso de Garotinho e definir eleição para o governo do RJ
item.description: The TSE will rule on whether Garotinho can withdraw his appeal against ineligibility, potentially electing Ruas in the first round. The decision impacts the possibility of a runoff between Ruas and Paes.

item.title: Após citar desorganização, Lula coloca petistas do Nordeste no comando da campanha
item.description: Lula announced the inclusion of three Northeastern politicians in the second-round campaign coordination to reverse underperformance and contain Flávio Bolsonaro's lead. Camilo Santana, Rui Costa and Rafael Fonteles will assume distinct roles amid internal criticism over disorganization and focus on legacy rather than everyday issues.

item.title: Mãe vai à Justiça após vídeo do filho com arma em ato do PL, diz jornal
item.description: The mother of a child who appeared holding a firearm-like object during a pro-Flavio Bolsonaro rally in Parnamirim (RN) has filed a lawsuit against the father, alleging child endangerment. The case is under investigation by child protection agencies and monitored by the Public Ministry. Although the father claims the object was a toy, laws prohibit displaying weapon replicas in risky situations.

item.title: “Flávio quer mudar a Constituição” tem aumento de buscas no Google
item.description: Senator and presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated plans to amend the Constitution via PEC to reform the judiciary, reduce the age of criminal responsibility, and end reelection, prompting a surge in Google searches exceeding 900%. The statements followed meetings with party leaders supporting his campaign for the second round. PEC approval requires two voting rounds in the Chamber with 308 favorable votes each.

item.title: ‘Caminho do precipício’, diz autor de pedido de impeachment de Dilma ao criticar Flávio
item.description: Miguel Reale Jr. criticizes Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential bid, calling it a 'path to the precipice' due to support for coup plotters and alignment with the U.S. government. He endorses Lula as an alternative to protect democracy and national sovereignty.
